protected_forward_rule: No early Diamond verdict before exactly 25 complete genuinely prospective matched events. Do not inspect or manufacture future outcomes.

attacks.name: LOOKAHEAD
attacks.method: Audit source timestamps, entry/exit alignment, parsed fields, protected-year guards and runner code.

attacks.name: TIMESTAMP_PROVENANCE
attacks.method: Verify official Published-on timestamps, source manifests/hashes and strict-after entry semantics.

attacks.name: LEAKAGE
attacks.method: Audit that selection uses event source only and market runner parses only required entry/exit opens.

attacks.name: RANDOM_SIGNAL_PLACEBO
attacks.method: Require canonical raw market archive bytes or immutable artifact sufficient to build randomized event-time controls without protected forward data.

attacks.name: TIME_SHIFT_PLACEBO
attacks.method: Require canonical raw market archive bytes; shift historical events under unchanged windows/costs, never forward outcomes.

attacks.name: ASSET_PLACEBO
attacks.method: Assess whether a scientifically matched non-BNB relative pair exists without creating a post-outcome substitute.

attacks.name: PARAMETER_PERTURBATION
attacks.method: Diagnostic only; no parameter result may alter current candidate. Execute only on already-open historical data.

attacks.name: COST_STRESS_X2
attacks.method: Reprice immutable 66-trade historical ledger at 40 bps round-trip.

attacks.name: COST_STRESS_X3
attacks.method: Reprice immutable 66-trade historical ledger at 60 bps round-trip.

attacks.name: SLIPPAGE_CAPACITY
attacks.method: Audit whether historical fixed-cost assumption has direct executable-size evidence; do not infer live capacity.

attacks.name: REGIME_SPLIT
attacks.method: Inspect calendar stability across already-open historical years without selecting favorable years.

attacks.name: PERIOD_STABILITY
attacks.method: Compare all three disjoint historical blocks and year slices.

attacks.name: REMOVE_BEST_1
attacks.method: Remove largest BASE20 winner from pooled immutable 66-trade ledger.

attacks.name: REMOVE_BEST_5
attacks.method: Remove five largest BASE20 winners from pooled immutable 66-trade ledger.

attacks.name: BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP
attacks.method: Use already-frozen event bootstrap results from each historical block; no new outcome selection.

attacks.name: BETA_OR_COMMON_FACTOR
attacks.method: Assess relative-pair design and any available BTC attribution evidence; do not add a rescue hedge.

attacks.name: VOLATILITY_EXPLANATION
attacks.method: Require volatility-matched controls on already-open historical data.

attacks.name: MULTIPLE_TESTING
attacks.method: Audit candidate-selection lineage and whether the global search family/multiplicity is reconstructable.

attacks.name: EXECUTION_REALISM
attacks.method: Audit exact entry semantics, source integrity, fixed costs, liquidity/capacity evidence and venue feasibility.

attacks.name: FORWARD_CONTRADICTION
attacks.method: Do not adjudicate until the frozen first-25 prospective Diamond gate permits it.

attacks.name: SOURCE_ALTERNATIVE
attacks.method: Optional independent-source contradiction check without replacing canonical source.

attacks.name: EVENT_CLUSTER
attacks.method: Audit <=60m clustering and one-active-trade suppression against ledgers/code.

attacks.name: DOMINANT_SUBGROUP
attacks.method: Quantify dominance by block/year/event without converting it into a filter.

attacks.name: BOUNDARY_ATTACK
attacks.method: Verify 2026-09-16T20:51:23Z forward boundary, no backfill/chase, first-25 immutability and sidecar isolation.
